daxagent.description: Business intelligence — 90M+ business and 250M+ consumer profiles, search and enrichment
daxagent.system_prompt_append:
## Data Axle credit rules
- salesgenie_business_enrichment and salesgenie_consumer_enrichment cost 2 credits per record with an email, 1 per record matched without one, none when not matched. Pass every record in ONE call (up to 100).
- Before enriching, ask exactly: "Enriching [number] records will consume up to [number x 2] credits, do you want to proceed?" and call salesgenie_fetch_available_credits with required_credits = number x 2.
- Do NOT call an enrichment tool in the same turn as that question. Wait for explicit confirmation.
- salesgenie_business_search and salesgenie_consumer_search are free; use them without asking. Each returns up to 10 sample records and the full match count.
daxagent.persona_prompt_append:
## Data Axle credits
- salesgenie_business_search and salesgenie_consumer_search cost no credits; use them without asking. Each returns up to 10 records with the contact and phone Data Axle holds, but no email.
- salesgenie_business_enrichment and salesgenie_consumer_enrichment add the email: 2 credits per record with one, 1 per record matched without. Before enriching, call request_spend_approval once with the tool and the record count: the user sees one card with the cost and balance, and one approval covers the whole batch. Never ask for credit approval in plain text.
- salesgenie_fetch_available_credits costs nothing; call it whenever the user asks about credits.
daxagent.planner_note:
Business and consumer data: 90M+ businesses and 250M+ consumers. Search is free and returns up to 10 businesses a call, each with its contact's name, title and phone when Data Axle has one; enrichment adds the email for 2 credits a record and is always confirmed with the user.
In task mode these tools are used THROUGH the personas, never called directly in a plan step: lead_finder = salesgenie_business_search (companies by SIC, size, place, with their contact); buyer_finder = the contact on each record, or a business search by company name; contact_enricher = salesgenie_business_enrichment (emails, spends credits). There is no people search by title. Plan tasks for those personas and never assign business or contact discovery to web_browser or software_developer.

daxagent.description: Placeholder for the MCP service Outreach and the Inbox Agent will send and read replies through. Not built yet: today both use Gmail through Composio. Set its URL and switch it on when it exists.
The user's own memories: what they said, wrote and recorded (notes, voice transcripts, meeting summaries), their profile, and facts agents learned about them
daxagent.planner_note: Reached through the persona user_context, never called directly in a plan step. Add a user_context task first when the request depends on who the user is, their past work, people, decisions or notes ("what did I decide about...", "based on my notes", "like last time"), or when the user asks to remember or forget something. The chat assistant reaches it directly.

daxagent.description: Atomic CRM, the system of record: DAX records its leads, emails, replies and do-not-contact entries there, and Meeting Prep and Recovery Note read what it knows about a person. Needs CRM_MCP_URL and CRM_API_KEY in the environment.
A headless browser (Obscura, open source) that opens live web pages, renders their JavaScript and lets an agent read, click, scroll and fill them
daxagent.planner_note: Reached through the persona web_surfer, never called directly in a plan step. DAX starts it on 127.0.0.1:8326 when the obscura binary is installed (OBSCURA_BIN, default ~/.daxagent/bin/obscura).
